2026-08-14 06:52:35.934194 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934199 | controller |
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934204 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934213 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934216 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934220 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934223 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-14 06:52:35.934228 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
